audio_pass.note: The probe version used for this run also attached video frames in audio mode; this pass is mixed audio/video, not audio-only.

verified: Official MiniCPM-o-Demo three-service stack (GPU backend, worker, gateway) started and passed health checks; worker registered
Client input streamed at real-time cadence: 100 audio chunks (1 s each) with 100 video frames in video mode; the second pass sent 71 audio chunks and 71 video frames
GPU processing: every one of the 125 video-mode response deltas carried vision metrics (1 slice, 64 tokens per chunk); per-chunk wall clock p50 868 ms
Speech/audio output over the interface: 29 chunks / 28.5 s (video mode) and 33 chunks / 32.6 s (audio mode) of non-silent audio (RMS ~0.11), saved as 24 kHz WAV on the device
Listen/speak overlap: input kept streaming for 93.7 s (video) and 64.8 s (audio) after the first audio delta arrived; sender and receiver ran concurrently
Model-side state switching on new input: delta pattern L4 S41 L5 S15 L60 in video mode; the model stopped its speaking turn and returned to listening when new input arrived
not_verified: Live microphone/speaker interaction with a human; no human listening assessment of the output audio
Human barge-in (user interrupting mid-sentence); only the model yielding to new recorded input was observed
End-to-end latency as perceived by a person; chunk wall-clock times are not conversational latency
Clean-room installation: the exploratory environment does not pass pip check (decord recognized as missing; PyTorch outside the model card range); installation of a new venv was not completed
notes: Services were started only for this run and stopped afterwards; gateway/worker/backend ports were verified released.
